module.purpose: API route that applies booking-request protections, enriches the request with its web origin, and delegates booking creation to the booking service.
module.summary: This Next.js API handler receives booking data, derives the client IP, optionally validates a Cloudflare Turnstile token, enforces core rate limiting, loads the authenticated server session, and marks the booking as originating from the web application. It then passes the enriched request, authenticated user identity, host, and forced-slug header to the booking creation workflow. A shared responder adapts the handler to the API route contract.
module.businessContext: Supports web-based booking creation while enforcing abuse protection and associating bookings with authenticated users or anonymous callers. Failures can block booking creation or allow unprotected traffic if safeguards are bypassed.
functions: handler (~L10-37): Validates protections, enriches booking data, and creates a booking.
systemCapabilities: Propagate booking host and slug context

units.name: handler

detail.name: handler
detail.signature: async function handler(req: NextApiRequest & { userId?: number })
preconditions: The request provides a body usable as booking data.
The request provides an IP address resolvable by getIP(req).
The imported booking, session, rate-limit, and Turnstile dependencies are available.
postconditions: The request body is augmented with creationSource set to CreationSource.WEBAPP before booking creation is delegated.
Booking creation receives the resolved client IP as the rate-limit identifier.
Booking creation receives the authenticated session user ID when present, otherwise -1.
Booking creation receives the request host, defaulting to an empty string when absent.
Any dependency failure is propagated rather than converted into a documented success response.
invariants: When NEXT_PUBLIC_CLOUDFLARE_USE_TURNSTILE_IN_BOOKER is exactly "1", Turnstile verification is awaited before rate limiting and booking creation.
Rate limiting is awaited before session lookup and booking creation.
The forced slug is taken from the x-cal-force-slug request header when present.
edgeCases: When the Turnstile feature flag is not exactly "1", Turnstile verification is skipped.
When the Turnstile feature flag is exactly "1", req.body.cfToken is passed as the token and the resolved request IP is passed as remoteIp.
When no authenticated session user ID exists, booking creation receives userId -1.
When the Host header is absent, booking creation receives hostname "".
When x-cal-force-slug is absent, booking creation receives an undefined forcedSlug.
If Turnstile verification, rate limiting, session retrieval, or booking creation fails, the resulting error is propagated.

raises: Errors rejected by checkCfTurnstileToken, checkRateLimitAndThrowError, getServerSession, or handleNewBooking
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: Dependency errors are propagated; no local validation or fallback error response is specified.

stateMutations: req.body is replaced with a shallow copy containing all prior body fields plus creationSource: CreationSource.WEBAPP.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Accepts a Next.js API request with an optional numeric userId property. Reads body.cfToken, headers.host, and headers["x-cal-force-slug"], and mutates req.body by adding creationSource before delegating booking creation.
detail.summary: Processes a booking API request by applying optional Cloudflare Turnstile verification and rate limiting, then obtains the server session and delegates booking creation with normalized request context.
